rows.title: Process visibility leaks agent identity across tenant boundary
rows.acceptance: procvis host-verify gate enforces hidepid=2 on the /proc mount itself (host must boot/mount with hidepid=2), not just inside ephemeral throwaway namespaces; refusal text names the exact missing property; table/verify unit tests green; go build/vet/test green

rows.title: /run/bunker directory enumeration exposes tenant runtime paths
rows.acceptance: the /run/bunker PARENT directory is mode 0700 root:root (or per-agent dirs made un-enumerable); existing per-agent 0700+chown assertion (AssertAgentSocketDir) preserved; socket contract /run/bunker/<id>/docker.sock still works for the owner unit; spawn unit tests green; go build/vet/test green
